notes: Hostile source-only audit against data/bill-text/119-HR-915.txt = H.R. 915 Engrossed in House (EH), 'Passed the House of Representatives June 24, 2026' (2219 chars, full read). No referencedSources registered, so bill text is the sole source. All bill-content claims (summary/brief/top_lines/sections/underreported/gaps/changes) verify verbatim against the new 7(a)(38) text and the three Section 2(b) rules of construction; expand/add direction and the discretionary 'may' modal are preserved, and all three negative rules of construction retain correct polarity. 0 material flags. Minor open rows are all peripheral: 'main' program gloss (unsourced ranking of 7(a)); prior short title 'Small Business Technological Act of 2025' (version-diff metadata, not in the Engrossed source); one coverage omission (the 'or any such technology' catch-all dropped from the covered-uses phrasing); and six likelihoodReason items that are Congress.gov/cache metadata (sponsor Alford R-MO, 3 cosponsors, 414-4 vote, motion-to-suspend, Senate referral) or permitted Zone-3 likelihood reasoning - none present in the bill text but all permitted structural/analytical inputs. Stage/vote cross-check: source confirms House passage on the stated date; cache vote result 'Passed' 414-4 is consistent with stage 'Passed House' - no drift. Congressional Record featured_quotes (Alford, Olszewski) are out of scope for this bill-text audit.
